passages.excerpt_preview: he volume places Chola expeditions in Asian history and distinguishes Rajaraja's early eleventh-century expansion from Rajendra I's 1025 expedition against Srivijaya.
Maritime mobility, ports and trade mattered to Chola power, but surviving evidence does not provide a modern-style roster or technical description of a permanent navy under Rajaraja.
